summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG across Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, run choices and resume location. Shared registries and handlers coordinate global play while cell scenes and local simulations compose spaces and stories; Kyoto Dreams (Level 178) now pairs its authored house and residents with a seven-quest chain, found gear and readables, while the tutorial remains solo and ephemeral. The Game Rules Manager presents creator rules from Markdown files in the HUD and god-mode rail, with edits mirrored through world.state.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; momentsV gates fitted wall moments and room-prop regeneration, and objects.scene hosts shared controllers.
places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; Test Range has loot/enemy bays and HIT SQUAD pad.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations and Camp Amber crews; sim builds tunnels/doors and staffs camps; t5-a2 leads to Level 178.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office route; scene owns geometry, sim/cutscenes supply route props and local beats.
places/level1 + places/level4 + places/level26 (3D) - M.E.G. camps and office mazes; Level 26's S.S. Fun has cabin 23, Partygoer decks/lockdown and aboard gate; Level 1 includes Dina's radio.

places/level9 + places/level11 + places/level61 + places/level70 (3D) - seeded Suburbs, city/Base Beta/strip mall/clinic and Chapter 2 trail, Snackrooms food court/checkpoint, and Froidetown winter market/civic town.
places/level169 (3D, Welcome to the Desert) - seeded desert, Ferry's house/trail/pantry/basement, scheduled Friends, checkpoints/ship and Field Office 7 with Backrooms Robotics.

places/level178 (3D, Kyoto Dreams) - authored machiya/courtyard spring with eight friendly resident rounds; the Hub door is the sole exit, and house props support A Place to Rest plus six follow-on quests, found weapons, clothing, readables and breakables.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera setup, ordered behaviors and input actions; fall-guard runs before movement and radio is on the player.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generation/tick behavior; selected sims compose shared helpers.
places/level169/config.yaml + scripts/terrain169.js - seeded height/material generator and desert marks; cell scenes hold placed flora.
places/level169/sim.js + scripts/lib/data/level169.yml + house/Ferry/Friends/road/Robotics helpers - dynamic desert setpieces, cast schedules, routes, quests and units.

places/level178/config.yaml + scripts/terrain178.js + x0z0.scene + sim.js - terrain and authored Kyoto house, resident rounds, arrival quest, one-time weapon/find and quest-spot placement, plus breakable sweep.
scripts/lib/level178-quests.js - Kyoto quest registry/steps; entry points are sim tick, npc-starters dialogue choices, talk.js reply handler and l178-prop.js prop-use handler.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js - title/settings, new-expedition choices, five-slot save manager and story/tutorial lifecycle; completed players can return to Bonus Rooms.

world.config.yaml + scripts/ui.js - shared HUD/menu surface and global actions; UI embeds mods/game-rules-manager/lib/panel.js; keep its import/render splice and rulesSave/rulesLoad actions coordinated, and unwire before removing the mod.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical per-place names, labels and HUD titles; consumed by feed, quest names and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - common pursuit/lurk/wake/retreat/bite behavior configured by l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js; companion.js/carry.js handle followers and held-prop transfers.
scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - separate Bonus shared-room routing and Hub tunnel/door/key registry; t5-a2 maps to Level 178.
scripts/lib/containment.js - Level 109 persistent pen/loose-foe, open-door and remembered-door-position books; sim supplies room IDs/boxes and spawnFoe adapter.

scripts/lib/pg-society.js + scripts/lib/data/pg-society.yml - Level 26 Partygoer roles/routes, sight-bound relay and deck alert/search/recovery; partygoers.js owns actor behavior/traps. scripts/lib/npc-gear.js + fresh-aura.js provide shared NPC gear/aura helpers.

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data - shared usable-prop/container migration and geometry specs; scripts/interact.js dispatches interactions. scripts/lib/voices.js resolves NPC voice IDs/cast pools and recorded takes.

scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - shared prop/wall damage, materials, salvage and regrowth; local sims call sweepProps and idMat rules classify placed props including Kyoto washi, ceramic and bamboo.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; per-level adapters retain level-specific cell/block rules.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js expose update with separate configurations.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.
scripts/lib/quests.js - journal/advancement/reward helpers; containment.js - pen/door operations; ch2-quest.js - Chapter 2 stages/dialogue helpers.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js - OPTS, DEFAULTS, PICK_DEFAULTS, RATE, PRESETS, runOf, needsMul, sanityMul, noStory, noNpcs, cleanPick, KEEP, SKIP; scripts/main-menu.js - SLOTS.

scripts/lib/breakables.js - sweepProps, tickWalls, REGROW_MS; scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - HOLD; scripts/lib/level178-quests.js - SPOTS, QUESTS178, REWARDS, touch178, questTick178, l178Choices, handleDialogueQuest178.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, currency and related progress.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats them; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates xpCurve progression.
scripts/lib/modifiers.js - player.state bookBonuses/readBooks/genericBooksRead/effects and modifier derivation; scripts/lib/clothes.js owns worn gear records whose passives feed modifiers.
scripts/lib/manuals.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.recipes stores learned recipe IDs; legacy player.state.manuals grants all recipes of those kinds.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - player.state.run owns expedition picks; run options determine story/NPC presence and hunger/thirst/sanity drain multipliers.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - SQL saves table owns named save-slot snapshots by player owner and slot; player.state remains live/current run state.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js + scripts/lib/tutorial.js - player.state.t0n/t0cut/t0Done/t0fade track tutorial beats; guideSeen/guideTip/guideMuted track Field Guide state/preferences.

scripts/lib/compass.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.compass charges and compassOn/compassRead dial state; Level 178 quest progress is per-player in l178q/l178k/l178u/l178a/l178l/l178b/l178t and supporting beat keys, paid once at 99; mods/game-rules-manager/rules.js owns world.state.grm sourced from rules/*.md.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV and radio behaviors; scripts/interact.js finds focused tagged props and dispatches their usable handlers.

templates/player.js runs scripts/fall-guard.js before movement; place changes hold velocity for ground streaming, grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; body3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose; camera discards an unparented stray view.

scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on place arrival to repair implausibly future-dated state timestamps.

scripts/main-menu-ui.js actions → scripts/main-menu.js → player.state.run or SQL saves; new-run reset retains NEW_KEEP screen/menu/save-list keys and clears character state; after t0Done pause Return routes to Bonus Rooms.
scripts/main-menu.js forces player/world bodyStyle to furry and ignores style actions; scripts/lib/critter-model.js setStyle always clears HUMAN, so character models are furry-only.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js → main-menu story gates Dina/Chapter 2/cutscenes; global sim.js removes npc-tagged people only when all players in a place choose noNpcs, and Phoebe only when all choose noStory.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; threshold door handlers call carryAcross → held props and nearby following companions cross; Bonus/world/room links are excluded and Bonus train rides set their own destination.
scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone (Level 178 maps to l178_house); scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles, markers and compass place names.

scripts/lib/npc-starters.js adds l178Choices to resident talk cards → scripts/talk.js handleDialogueQuest178 handles chosen reply; sim.js questTick178 advances position beats, while l178-prop.js use → touch178 handles quest spots/taps and dialogue/props → quests.js journal, once-only rewards and player progress.

places/level178/sim.js auto-starts A Place to Rest and ticks the six follow-on quests; level178.yml finds → sim spawns weaponBody props once, wardrobe/container data grants clothing and weapons, and only the paired Hub threshold routes out.

Level 178 read-kind props → player.state.reading page ID → scripts/ui.js lazy-loads scripts/lib/data/pages.yml into the reading panel; npc-starters/talk dialogue → scripts/lib/voices.js resolves cast lines through voice-acted2.yml to packed audio hashes.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon + places/level61/sim.js and scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - authored commercial interiors and simulated staff/services; menus/staff vary by venue and Level 6.1 fixtures are fitted separately.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes a table with separately fitted chairs.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/ballistics.js + scripts/lib/knock.js - weapon variants share combat; sounds/rack/reload/liquid effects and swing/hold presentation vary by weapon; Kyoto adds bokken and kiseru finds plus quest-reward katana/naginata.

art/cigs/build.py + art/fnv/build.py + art/xmas-clean/build.py and NIF converters, plus cat-wardrobe fitting and level70-stall parts - fitted GLBs/prop catalogs and body-specific garment/prop fitting; Kyoto adds fitted yukata/haori, tabi/geta, hachimaki and kitsune mask wardrobe mappings.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.

scripts/lib/l169-road.js + scripts/lib/l169-road-geo.js + scripts/lib/l169-travel.js + scripts/lib/l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

art/kyoto/build_arch.py + build_props.py + kit.py + garden/build.py + shell2/build_structure.py + shell2/build_walls.py + fit178.py - shared Blender builders and fitted Kyoto assets; Level 178 scene/data aligns story props, breakable material ID rules and house units.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries the material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players; player roots and local-audience objects are skipped.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs and destinations together. t5-a2 is OPEN to Level 178; l178-to-hub pairs with the sim-created hub-from-l178 marker.

Level 13's building shell is authored in cells/x0z0.scene; sim.js returns if l13-floor is absent and no longer regenerates the shell. Preserve matching floor ID and scene wall/threshold geometry; LETH remains in player.state.leth13.

Level 169 uses x/z with north at -z and 1:10 map scale; terrain marks, track, house, road sites, Field Office 7 and ship berth must align. level169.yml holds tuned positions/rules; sim layout version and well version are separate.

Level 178 positions in scripts/lib/data/level178.yml use metres, north = -Z, house floor y=0.45; keep shell2 module frames/pivots and assets.txt hashes aligned with the authored scene, usable target IDs/coordinates and basin collider dimensions. The quest chain's one-time steps/rewards key off per-player state; route beats never create another exit from the Hub door.

Breakables use data idMat ID regexes for placed-prop classification; preserve IDs/material mapping and tear material slots for shoji. Regrowth timing/near-player avoidance is shared; Kyoto ceramic/washi/bamboo drops are salvage and its story-prop IDs must stay aligned with those rules.
